newsitem.title: THAILAND: National Petrochem in maintenance closure.
newsitem.headline: National Petrochem in maintenance closure.

text.p: Thailand's National Petrochemical Plc will temporarily shut down its operations between April 23-May 20 for maintenance, a company official said on Monday.
The company suspends its olefins operations for major maintenance once every three years, the official told Reuters.
But the firm had reserved enough stock for use in related industries during the shutdown, he added.
NPC produces 528,000 tonnes of ethylene and propylene a year. The product is used as major feedstock in the plastics industry.
